svg.title: Fleet View
svg.desc: A print farm floor plan seen from above; one rack pulled out into its front view, drawn as a cabinet with a name rail per shelf, with shelf 2 selected and a selection pill offering Pause and Preheat for its four printers.

text.tspan: Your print farm as racks, shelves
and slots. Select any of them and
